structural_breaks.note: FY2018 annual report 释义 adds 变压器 (power transformers) to 线圈类产品 (2016-2018H1 definition: 中性点接地产品、电抗器、互感器). Prior-year FY2017 figure (820.79) was NOT recast, so the company treats the series as continuous; the transformer contribution before FY2018 is unknown.
FY2019 annual report renames to 线圈类及相关产品 and adds 油色谱及在线监测系统 (DGA online monitoring, previously in 智能设备类); FY2018 comparative (965.61) not recast.

2025 product structure: 开关类/变压器类/保护及自动化类/电力电子类/EPC类/储能系统及元件类/租赁. FY2024 annual report printed only an industry split (no product split) so FY2024H2 is missing; 2025 AR recasts FY2024 变压器类业务 = 3,348.38 and the 2026 H1 report recasts 2025H1 = 2,010.10. Values from FY2025H1 on are 变压器类业务 and are not strictly comparable with 线圈类及相关产品 (FY2024H1 1,673.91).

profile.products: Per FY2025 annual report (p.10-11 主要业务): ≤1000kV GIS & GIL, ≤800kV SF6 circuit breakers and disconnectors, ≤500kV DC breakers, ≤35kV GIS/C-GIS and ring-main units, LV apparatus, ≤500kV current transformers, ≤1000kV voltage transformers, ±800kV AC/DC bushings, ≤750kV power transformers, ≤750kV reactors, ≤66kV neutral-grounding sets, ≤1000kV capacitor banks, ≤1000kV substation protection & monitoring (secondary) systems, DGA online monitoring, SVG/STATCOM, HV active filters, static synchronous condensers (SSC), utility-scale and residential storage systems, automotive electronics, supercapacitor cells/modules, high-power Li cells, mobile/prefabricated substations; plus EPC. Make-to-order/ETO. 2025 product revenue: 开关类 8,935m (41.5%), 变压器类 4,633m (21.5%), 保护及自动化 2,542m, 电力电子 1,525m, EPC 2,332m, 储能系统及元件 1,531m.

collection_notes: Primary sources only: periodic reports on cninfo (static.cninfo.com.cn finalpage PDFs, listed via the cninfo hisAnnouncement/query API). Text extracted with pypdf and pdfplumber; every quarter cross-checked.

revenue_total values FY2015-FY2025 = annual report 分季度主要财务指标 (direct 3-month figures). Verified: Σ4 quarters = FY 营业收入 (±0.05m) every year; Q1 = Q1 report; Q1+Q2 = H1 report; Q1..Q3 = Q3 report 年初至报告期末; Q3 = Q3 report 本报告期. No discrepancies for Sieyuan (no restatements affecting revenue; FY2023 AR shows 调整前=调整后 for FY2022).
FY2026Q1 = 2026 Q1 report (direct); FY2026Q2 = 2026 H1 report 营业收入 10,795.21 − Q1 4,568.66 (ytd_difference).
Text-layer of some Sieyuan PDFs (2020, 2021, 2023 AR) is character-scrambled in pypdf; values were re-read with pdfplumber and all passed the sum checks.
